body_markdown:
The following features and fixes are available on the[latest](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/version-management) channel and are candidates for the next stable release:


### Changes


-


**1.500.0:** Fixed Page Anchors not scrolling in the editor's preview window.


-


**1.501.0:** Added[custom theme](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/image-editor/configuration#theme) support to the[Image Editor](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/image-editor/quickstart) .


-


**1.502.0:** Fixed missing image width CSS in exports until the width slider was manually toggled.


-


**1.503.0:** Fixed apostrophes in image filenames being HTML-escaped instead of URL-encoded.


-


**1.505.0:** Fixed whole-design generation being cancelled when the AI Assistant was used in edit mode.


-


**1.506.0:** Fixed missing AI-generated image alt text, false success reports, and overlapping merge tag menus.


-


**1.508.0:** Fixed synced blocks moving down one row after each refresh.


-


**1.509.0:** Retired legacy AI tools and moved access to per-subscription extensions.


-


**1.511.0:** Added shared rate limiting across Unlayer services, with consistent 429 responses and retry guidance.


-


**1.512.0:** Replaced retired Gemini models used for Magic Image and Image Editor AI generation and editing.


-


**1.513.0:** Fixed typing and selection around smart merge tags in the Paragraph and Heading tools.


-


**1.514.0:** Added a one-time $10 Inbox Previews trial for Scale, Optimize, and Enterprise plans.


-


**1.515.0:** Added image generation and AI image editing to the AI Assistant and public Images API.


-


**1.516.0:** Fixed Countdown Timers disappearing in Outlook when images are blocked by preserving the timer and showing its end date as alternate text.


-


**1.520.0:** Add Cmd/Ctrl+K link shortcut to Paragraph and Heading tools.
